100:t_100:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is he in $$ネオ・ジオン$$ too!?」

100:t_100:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I have no obligation to answer a man I'm about to defeat!」

100:t_101:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「All I need is the $$ユニコーン$$! $$バナージ・リンクス$$! I'll pay you back for everything you've done!」

100:t_101:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you fighting over something so petty!?」

100:t_101:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What do you know about me!? Pay with your body for the disrespect you showed the Colonel!!」

100:t_102:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop fighting, $$ハマーン$$! Earth and space can't afford to fight each other!」

100:t_102:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Shut up, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$! If the $$地球連邦$$ lacks the strength to fight the $$新地球皇国$$, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will take the lead!」

100:t_102:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't let your talents rot either! Come to my side!」

100:t_102:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What good will fighting over power do now!? Don't lose sight of what you need to do!」

100:t_102:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You never stop getting on my nerves! It seems we really are incompatible!」

100:t_103:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$... Its existence could be our trump card.」

100:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It has the power to change the world... But even if we had something like that now...!」

100:t_103:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It is precisely now that we need that power to guide this world!」

100:t_104:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ハマーン$$! You saw the light of people's hearts at $$アクシズ$$ too!」

100:t_104:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Then people's hearts united in their wish for the future, whether they were from Earth or space!」

100:t_104:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Stop fighting, $$ハマーン$$! This kind of fighting will only close off humanity's future!」

100:t_104:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Be quiet, $$アムロ・レイ$$. I cannot entrust humanity's future to the incompetent, powerless $$地球連邦$$.」

100:t_104:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I will unite humanity and confront the threat! Lend me your strength!」

100:t_104:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're just like $$シャア$$ used to be!」

100:t_104:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't act on logic alone! The words of someone like that can't move anyone!」

100:t_105:1.en:
$n
「Don't think I'll always be an amateur...! I fought through the $$時獄戦役$$ too!」

100:t_105:2.en:
$n
「And let me tell you something else...! Until Earth is free, I don't intend to die, no matter who I'm up against!」

100:t_105:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then let me teach you something too. I'll teach you your place...!」

100:t_106:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Don't overdo it, $$刹那$$. The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ can't make full use of your power.」

100:t_106:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「Even so, I can't retreat. If we leave $$ネオ・ジオン$$ alone, the fighting will spread.」

100:t_106:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「As long as you understand that, it's fine.」

100:t_106:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'll cover you...! Move as you see fit!」

100:t_106:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「I understand...! I'm $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$...! The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ is engaging!」

100:t_107:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「He's an $$イノベイター$$...!」

100:t_107:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「Stop fighting...! You know that people can understand each other and unite their hearts!」

100:t_107:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're just like $$カミーユ・ビダン$$...! You confuse understanding each other with barging uninvited into someone's heart!」

100:t_107:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「And know this! Earth's humanity no longer has the luxury of waiting for people to grow!」

100:t_108:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You throw the enemy into confusion, and I shoot them down... That's not a bad combination.」

100:t_108:1.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ロックオン$$...! $$マリー$$ and I will hold the enemy back!」

100:t_108:2.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Leave it to me! We'll send those fools who can't see the state of the world packing!」

100:t_109:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we keep fighting $$ネオ・ジオン$$ like this, we won't be able to stop the $$新地球皇国$$...!」

100:t_109:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「I understand! We'll attack $$ハマーン$$ and learn as much as we can about their intentions!」

100:t_109:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Enemy units are directly ahead...!」

100:t_109:3.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「All of the $$トレミー$$'s systems are operating normally!」

100:t_109:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Begin the attack...! We're going on the offensive now too!」
